source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC-Web -> Overview.
2. Check Network information.
3. Click "View more" to check.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information should match SPEC definition.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/EthernetInterfaces (network information (IP/MAC)) so user confirms the BMC web "network information" page shows the correct data. No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES recognizes the relevant read-only interface collection, but assumes ManagerId `bmc`, may return only member links, narrows all network information to IP/MAC and neither selects the correct management interface nor tests Overview/View-more. `-k` and command-line credentials undermine endpoint identity, and `No RISK` ignores nearby apply/edit controls that can disconnect management.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly adds interface disambiguation, DHCP/VLAN/address-family semantics, read-only navigation and alternate recovery. This review strengthens collection-member traversal, current-management-path preservation, shared/dedicated/failover identity, address-origin/lifetime evidence and an explicit no-refresh/no-retry boundary.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 854/2291 accepts the fixed Manager path as a direct-run check and does not verify collection members, UI `View more`, management-interface selection, address origin/lifetime, shared-versus-dedicated path or safe separation from network-edit actions.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1017 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the Overview/View-more method; ED-34 makes the interface/address matrix a Project readiness input; ED-35 rejects API-only or IP/MAC-only substitution for the full source coverage; ED-38 prohibits unapproved network mutation, requires recovery-path validation, no automatic retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify that Network information shown in the BMC Overview and `View more` identifies the correct management interface or interfaces and matches the Project SPEC for MAC, address configuration and other required link/network fields without changing BMC connectivity.
original_method: On the exact BMC WebUI and role, capture the Network information summary, open `View more` once and enumerate every required field. Discover the target Manager and each EthernetInterfaces member through a trusted read-only path, map UI entries to physical/shared/dedicated/failover identities, and compare current values plus configuration semantics with the approved Project matrix.
manual_activity: The Project owner defines which BMC management ports/interfaces are expected, their shared/dedicated/failover roles and the exact network-field acceptance matrix. Automation can perform read-only UI/API correlation after approval; an engineer handles topology ambiguity, protects the active management path and owns the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact BMC endpoint/certificate, controller identity, firmware and WebUI build plus the presently used management path
Physical port to Redfish-interface mapping for dedicated, shared, sideband, virtual and failover interfaces with stable ID and permanent/current MAC expectations
Per-interface Project values and semantics for IPv4/IPv6, DHCP/static origin, prefix/mask, gateway, DNS, VLAN, hostname/FQDN, link, speed and address lifetimes as applicable
Overview and View-more labels, ordering, role visibility, locale/format, route/selector and page-ready signal
Discovered Manager member and EthernetInterfaces collection/member/OEM mappings without assuming fixed IDs
Alternate OOB recovery, trusted TLS, protected credentials, sensitive-address redaction and explicit no-edit/no-apply boundary
safety_requirements: Do not edit, apply, reset, enable, disable, renew, release, fail over or otherwise change any BMC interface, IP, DHCP, VLAN, route, DNS or hostname in this information-only testcase.

Do not assume ManagerId `bmc`, the first EthernetInterfaces member or the current URL's address identifies the sole management interface. Discover and correlate every in-scope member with hardware/topology evidence.
Treat collection responses as discovery; follow required member URIs and record address origin, state, lifetime and VLAN/context rather than comparing bare IP/MAC strings.
Do not use `curl -k` or expose reusable credentials. Validate the target certificate and retain a separately verified alternate OOB recovery path before navigating a page containing network controls.
Do not clear system, SEL, BMC network or audit logs and do not trigger a refresh/renew operation merely to make data current. Record timestamps and lease/state freshness instead.
Navigate once and stop without automatic retry on reachability change, edit-mode entry, apply request, wrong-interface mapping, transient failover, identity mismatch or ambiguous stale address.
agent_execution_scope: Establish BMC identity, current access path and alternate recovery, then discover the Manager and EthernetInterfaces members read-only before opening detailed UI controls.
Capture Overview and invoke only the `View more` navigation control; record all Project-defined fields without entering edit/apply modes.
Correlate each UI interface with its Redfish/OEM member using stable identifier, role, MAC, address family, VLAN/link and physical-path evidence; compare current/configured values to the matrix.
Report absent, extra, stale, temporary, failover, link-down and permission-filtered values separately; preserve logs and never issue DUT PASS/FAIL or retry automatically.
engineer_actions: Approve the port/interface/topology map and the complete field/value/semantics matrix for each expected management path.
Approve UI-to-Redfish/OEM mappings, transient-address/failover handling, redaction and the alternate recovery path.
Review the per-interface UI/API/SPEC comparison and proof that no network request was submitted, then issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The EthernetInterfaces collection is a useful discovery resource, but the fixed ManagerId can be wrong and the collection envelope may not include member details. IP/MAC alone cannot establish interface role, DHCP/static semantics, VLAN/link state or View-more correctness; insecure TLS and exposed credentials also invalidate the formal method.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through trusted TLS and protected authentication, discover the Manager from `/redfish/v1/Managers`, GET its EthernetInterfaces collection and each approved member, then map those records to the Overview and View-more interface fields and signed Project topology/value matrix without invoking PATCH or UI apply controls.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Overview, `View more`, all-information SPEC criterion, absent Script and 10/0-minute estimates remain preserved; API evidence supplements rather than replaces the WebUI workflow.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an interface-centric comparison keyed by stable component/port identity rather than array order, recording configured and current addresses with origin/lifetime/context and reconciling both WebUI views to discovered Redfish/OEM members and Project topology.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact BMC, management-network topology, firmware/WebUI build and role selected by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record Manager/EthernetInterface schema types, BMC firmware and UI build because address and failover properties vary by implementation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: DMTF Redfish Manager EthernetInterface data model, vendor shared/dedicated/failover mapping and signed Project network specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Retains summary/detail UI coverage, discovers rather than guesses resources, expands IP/MAC into a complete approved interface matrix and enforces a no-network-change boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A collection GET may prove only discoverability; API state may not prove UI labeling or selection; static snapshots do not validate failover, DHCP renewal or connectivity behavior; those functions require separate approved tests.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: BMC/port identity, topology, field matrix, UI/API mapping, address semantics, recovery path, credentials and redaction.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Network pages expose controls capable of severing management; failover and DHCP can change observed values during capture; multiple virtual/physical members can be mistaken for the active path.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use a vendor network API or switch-side read-only evidence when Redfish is incomplete, but must retain Overview and View-more checkpoints, record the actual tool and identity mapping, obtain engineer approval and disclose unverified original fields. An alternative read path cannot claim configuration-change or failover coverage.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/controller, firmware/WebUI build, trusted certificate, current management path and independently verified alternate OOB recovery
Signed physical-port/interface-role map and per-interface Project network field/value/semantics matrix
Redacted Overview and View-more screenshots/DOM/routes with role, locale, page readiness and timestamps

Discovered Manager URI, EthernetInterfaces collection and each in-scope member/OEM payload including stable ID, permanent/current MAC, address family/origin/lifetime, VLAN, link and other required fields
Per-interface UI-summary/UI-detail/API/SPEC comparison covering missing, extra, stale, temporary, failover and permission-filtered values
Evidence no edit/apply/renew/reset request or reachability change occurred, preserved audit logs, limitations and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a read-only Network information comparison in Overview and View more. Project-specific fields and DeepSeek's narrow fixed API path are incompleteness issues, not conflicting source purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The information-display purpose is clear. Interface topology, expected addresses/semantics, resource mapping and recovery are resolvable Project readiness inputs, so execution is gated under PACKAGE rather than permanent BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to PACKAGE, retains EthernetInterfaces only as a discovered read-only source and adds UI coverage, interface-role binding, full field semantics, trusted identity and no-edit safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its interface-aware hybrid approach and adds collection/member distinction, current-path protection, address-origin/lifetime evidence and a strict single-navigation/no-refresh rule.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces direct-run acceptance of a fixed partial API dump with an identity- and topology-bound UI/API/SPEC comparison.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents the wrong or merely first interface, a stale DHCP lease or a partial IP/MAC collection response from being accepted as the complete BMC network display, while avoiding accidental loss of management connectivity.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BMC can expose dedicated, shared, sideband, virtual and failover interfaces simultaneously. Addresses also carry origin, family, prefix, lifetime and VLAN context. Therefore correctness cannot be inferred from a flat IP/MAC dump or array order; every UI entry must be bound to a stable interface role and Project expectation. Because the same page may expose configuration controls, read-only navigation and an alternate recovery path are essential boundaries.
